title: Regulated status overbroad: any logged-Space member
description: SPEC l.3762 treats any member of a logging-enabled Space as regulated, so all their DMs (including with non-regulated contacts, outside the Space) are logged. Fix: regulated status must be an explicit per-identity attribute set by the employing CO, not inferred from Space membership. Line numbers refer to import/ files (notes/research-2026-10-16.md).
close_reason: Resolved or verified in P2 errata pass 2026-10-16
